_note: Narration engine for tools/narrate.mjs (decided Nov 8, 2026: Kokoro, local and free). Voices per series live in casting/<series>/cast.json; walk-ons and speaker fixes in casting/<series>/<code>.json. Model paths come from .env (KOKORO_MODEL, KOKORO_VOICES).
license: Kokoro-82M weights are Apache-2.0: commercial use allowed, no attribution required. Platforms still require AI-voice disclosure (config/platforms.json).

gemini._note: Full-cast backend (node tools/narrate.mjs <id> <code> --engine gemini). Voices per series: casting/<id>/cast.json gemini.voices; walk-ons: casting/<id>/<code>.json cast[].gemini. One speaker per request; pauses in seconds are the gaps added between requests. Rates from ai.google.dev pricing, checked 2026-11-09: $0.50/1M text in, $9/1M audio out through 2026-12-31 (doubles 2027-01-01), 25 audio tokens per second. rpm 0 = no pacing (429s are retried with backoff). Set paidTier true once the key has billing.

narrator.style: Warm British female audiobook narrator with a soft southern English accent, tremulous, quavering timbre, intimate and quiet, measured unhurried pace, natural dramatic pauses between paragraphs, atmospheric literary storyteller

gemini.characterStyle: Natural, unhurried British drama performance of a single line of dialogue in an audiobook
